entities.summary: The Dreikönigskirche is a Lutheran church located in the Innere Neustadt of Dresden, Germany. It is the centre of a parish, and a community venue called Haus der Kirche. The church is a listed cultural monument of Dresden. Dreikönigskirche is a church building in Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
